posts.text:
Folks. As much as I agree Netanyahu should face justice, arresting him when he arrives for UNGA would be patently illegal, and would end international norms that have facilitated diplomacy for hundreds of years. 

Also, we don’t recognize the ICC and couldn’t turn him over if we did arrest him.
posts.summary: Opposes arresting Netanyahu at UN; prioritizes diplomatic norms over ICC jurisdiction

posts.text:
Preventing some Iranian villagers from getting drinking water does nothing to prevent the IRGC from firing missiles and drones.

Water is a red line. I know those of you who hate the US military and US foreign policy won’t care about the difference, but it’s significant, with very bad implications.
posts.summary: Criticizes water sanctions as ineffective counterterrorism measure; warns of negative implications
